articles.title: Kraken in talks to buy 15% stake in DeFi lender Aave at $385 million valuation
articles.snippet: The DeFi lender is rebuilding after the fallout from April's KelpDAO exploit sparked a multibillion-dollar exodus of deposits despite Aave itself not being hacked.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: AAVE gains 10.1% as index rises
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Cash (BCH), up 5.8% from Wednesday, joined Aave (AAVE) as a top performer.

articles.title: Aave Token Could Climb 50x by End of 2030, Standard Chartered Says—Here's Why
articles.snippet: Bitcoin to $500K, Ethereum to $40K, and Aave to $3,500 by the end of 2030? Standard Chartered just laid out some bullish price targets.
